title: Planet Tweaks V3.3.0 NOVA TITAN - Zero Keyboard Acceptance Delay, 35GB ShadowStorage, Offline GamerTag Auth & Esports Rapid Repeat
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.3.0 NOVA TITAN: (1) Zero Acceptance Delay & Esports Rapid Repeat: Hardcoded DelayBeforeAcceptance=0, BounceTime=0, WaitMSec=0, 15ms repeat rate, and 150ms repeat delay with 100% safe rollback. (2) 35GB System Restore Storage: Enforced 35GB shadow storage limit with zero restore point wipes on rollback. (3) Offline Session Resilience: Graceful fallback for GamerTag authentication when offline or disconnected. (4) UI Refinement: Compact Windows Tools diagnostic deck, purged fake mouse peripherals, and consolidated Debloat tabs. (5) Guardian Angel Master Switch: Custom toggle under Settings.
